name: agentics-kit
description: Agentics plugin kit — developer tools, code review, planning, and CLAUDE.md optimization

metadata.description: Agentics plugin kit — developer tools, code review, planning, and CLAUDE.md optimization

plugins.name: memory-tools
plugins.description: Audit and optimize CLAUDE.md project memory files against Claude Code best practices

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Structured multi-dimensional code review across quality, bugs, security, best practices, complexity rating, breaking changes, and regressions

plugins.name: wcag-compliance-reviewer
plugins.description: Review HTML/CSS and React/TypeScript code for WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility compliance

plugins.name: skill-reviewer
plugins.description: Review and optimize Claude Code skill files — score SKILL.md quality, plan and scaffold new skills, audit allowed-tools permissions, optimize frontmatter (descriptions + disable-model-invocation), and enforce the three-part 200-char description format

plugins.name: code-testing-agent
plugins.description: Analyze code and suggest specific, purpose-driven tests tied to actual behavior and intent — not arbitrary coverage

plugins.name: git-agent
plugins.description: Automated git workflow — create branches, commit with conventional messages, create PRs, and open GitHub/GitLab issues from any context (selection, session, bug, feature) with host auto-detection and confirmation gate; ships background subagents and slash commands for fire-and-forget commit/PR/ship/CI-watch plus auto-linking plan issue references in PR descriptions

plugins.name: settings-sync
plugins.description: Back up and restore Claude Code user settings to a dedicated git repo — routine-compatible for automated backups

plugins.name: social-media-tools
plugins.description: Discover teachable code, blog posts, videos, GitHub snippets, and selected/pasted code — scrub for secrets, draft instructional platform-aware copy with concrete takeaways, and generate styled dark-mode social cards for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Bluesky, and Substack, plus a write-guide skill that writes long-form internal developer explainer guides to docs/

plugins.name: plan-agent
plugins.description: Plan creation, review, follow-through, and maintenance. Author a Markdown plan spec rendered as self-contained interactive HTML (implementation-plan), implement it end-to-end through the acceptance and completion gates (build), which authors a plan first when the command names none, and review it with a ten-reviewer Agent Team (review-plan) before marking it done (finalize-plan). Ship a whole backlog in parallel with one worktree agent per plan (build-fleet). Also ships build-proposal, build-feature, deep-grill, prompt, prototype, documenting-plans, markdown-to-html, plan-status, plan-maintenance, setup-sites, plans-library, and plans-open. Accepts issue URLs and .md plans as input; hooks enforce filenames and rebuild the plan gallery. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: team-defaults
plugins.description: Shared team defaults — documentation and design-token agents plus a sync-rules skill that installs the team's global rules into ~/.claude/rules/

plugins.name: artifact-tools
plugins.description: Publish diffs, sessions, plans, prompts, and teaching pages as live claude.ai artifact pages — an annotated diff walkthrough with per-hunk reviewer notes, a reviewer-first session recap, plan HTML republished to a stable URL, saved prompts published singly or as a filterable library with verbatim copy buttons, and a teach-artifact explainer that answers how a system works rather than what changed — plus three audience framings over the session recap: product-doc for stakeholders, team-recap for the whole team, and eng-recap for engineers, with architecture, code paths, tradeoffs, learnings, tests, and review follow-ups drawn from a capped read of the PR diff — with a blocking secret-scrub gate and a local-HTML fallback

plugins.name: content-tools
plugins.description: Turn work products into publishable site content — the artifact-to-post skill converts a local HTML artifact, pasted HTML, or a Markdown file into a draft MDX post for a static site, keeping interactive blocks interactive by scoping their CSS instead of screenshotting them, and guarding prose against MDX's JSX parsing rules
